newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Press Metal in bonus, rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Press Metal in bonus, rights issues.

text.p: Aluminium products maker Press Metal Bhd said it is proposing a bonus issue and rights issue and seeking to increase its authorised share capital.
In a statement sent late on Monday to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the company said it was proposing a bonus issue of 17.22 million to 24.35 million new shares on a one-for-two basis.

It is also seeking a rights issue of between 86.09 million and 121.76 million new shares at a price of 1.65 ringgit each on a five-for-two basis. This issue is expected to raise gross proceeds of about 142.05 million ringgit.
Proceeds of the rights issue will be used primarily for capital expenditures and for working capital, Press Metal said.
Press Metal is seeking to boost its authorised share capital from 50 million ringgit to 200 million ringgit, the statement further said.

The proposals will decrease the proforma net tangible asset of the company from 2.22 ringgit per share to about 1.60 ringgit a share, and are expected to "significantly improve" the gearing, or debt, of the company, it said.
It did not elaborate on the extent of the expected improvement in its gearing.
Press Metal is also involved in building and contracting works.
